sentence: Mehta et al. give competitive advantage a position between adoption and results: they test it as the channel through which AI adoption reaches performance, and predict a positive effect on performance in its own right
passage: [Mehta et al. (2025), p. 550] "H8. Competitive advantage has a significant and positive impact upon firm performance." / "H9. Competitive advantage has a mediating influence on adoption of AI technologies and firm performance."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately summarizes the two hypotheses from the passage, correctly identifying competitive advantage as a mediator and as having a direct predicted effect on performance.
